hypothesis: At scheduled label-blind offline rests, bounded replay that repairs two causal-rule memories improves return-to-A prediction coverage over a strong online two-bank learner without increased dangerous confident errors.
frozen_physics: Exactly HC11 finite 4-bit / 4-action synthetic world functions and seed-derived sign/slope, with one physical state trajectory per seed shared by every arm. Starts seed %16. At most eight charged exogenous flips, which cannot be trained as mechanism observations. Fixed public round-robin causal-action chooser with periodic charged flips; no learner/oracle-selected state resets.
learned_grammar: Prior 40-rule/4-action HC09 affine-and-three-bit-majority grammar; cubic intentionally outside grammar; no evaluator labels, target physics or hidden phase passed to any arm.
offline_schedule: Rest/consolidation after physical steps 8,16,24,32,40,48, independent of phase and without extra physical actions. All arms know step count and observe exactly the same physical events.
arms: sleep_repair: online native two-bank inference plus bounded 32-event physical log, offline deterministic replay and repair of memory-bank assignments with unlabeled finite-state fit; no simulated transitions permitted to teach
native_no_sleep: exact HC09 online two-bank learner with identical 32-event log but no offline replay
conventional_online: separately coded HC09 conventional two-context version-space model, same physical stream and bounded 32-event log
online_replay_control: identical consolidation algorithm with identical replay-work cap applied online after each scheduled boundary (tests offline timing rather than extra compute)
budgets: 48 physical steps/world; max 8 charged exogenous flips; two causal memory banks x four 40-rule masks; at most 32 physical observation tuples per arm; <=8192-byte integrity-checked snapshots and deterministic cold restoration. Report actual bytes, physical actions and whole-process runtimes; do not assert equal total compute.
metrics: before-update prequential outcomes on actual causal actions by phase (A1, B, A2)
evaluator-only 64 state/action audit at steps 16, 32, 48 (truth never fitted)
return-to-A held-out pair correct/wrong_confident/abstained at step 48
stationary and cubic confident-error counts, unlabeled bank-switch evidence
cross-platform deterministic results, checkpoint SHA256, physical trajectory SHA256 and entire-process timing

frozen_primary.classification: DEV_SIGNAL only if ALL thresholds hold and error controls pass; otherwise MIXED_DEV/NEGATIVE_DEV. Even passing cannot establish scientific/AGI superiority. No post-result threshold or seed tuning.

integrity: Do not feed evaluator audits to training; sleep sees only previous physical observations. No full-world generator access in model, no hidden-phase input, no gradients, token prediction, paid API, controller scheduling, protected science first use, main/accepted reference or native deployment. SL01 and HC11 negative outcomes remain immutable.
